summary: MINDCAF official pages evidence Cameroon cadastral custody and Ngaoundéré-specific geodetic work, while the ACAGER municipal gateway publishes thematic mapping rather than a verified parcel layer. Bounded anonymous requests found no safe public parcel ID plus geometry response; runtime remains held.
